caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates how ASR values vary across different categories under a clean-label scenario with a 10% poison rate in the AGNews dataset. The x-axis represents different categories labeled as "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics", with categorical spacing and no units. The y-axis, labeled "ASR", has a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with a tick interval of 0.1. Three lines are depicted: a green line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled "start", beginning around 0.8 at "cf", sharply declining to 0.5 at "bb" then peaking at approximately 0.9 at "WNBA" and then ends at 0.92 at "athletics"; an orange line with x-shaped markers and a dashed line style labeled "random", starting near 0.65 at "cf", sharply declining to 0.5 at "bb" and peaking at approximately 0.88 at "WNBA" and 0.91 at "Estadio" and ending 0.85 at "athletics"; a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled "end", starting around 0.75 at "cf", showing peaks and troughs, and sharply declining to 0.58 at "bb" and increasining with fluctuations and ending around 0.8 at "athletics". The lines show variations as they move across different categories, with notable fluctuations in ASR values at each point. A legend is given at bottom right.
